Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy

Record Class EnemySetup

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.enemy.EnemySetup
Record Components:
body - the box the enemy occupies in the world, already placed; also its hurtbox
stats - where its stats come from (GDD 1.6)
spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it, e.g. "enemies/rat"
invincibilityTicks - invincibility ticks granted after a hit; 0 or more
summoned - true if a summoner spawned it; a summoned enemy never drops loot (Q16)
world - the world it lives in: its walls stop it, its event bus hears its hits
public record EnemySetup(Aabb body, StatSource stats, String spriteId, int invincibilityTicks, boolean summoned, World world) extends Record
What every enemy is built from, whatever its family: the values of its data/characters.json entry that all enemies share, plus where it lives. The family adds its own values (reach, summons) next to it.
